errors.message: This QA session had only Read, Glob, Grep and SubagentHandback. No shell, git or cargo was available, so the delta 085dab4..6972530 could not be diffed and no acceptance command (cargo test, just lint, just test) could be executed. Static reading confirmed the branch and HEAD (see note below). Every acceptance row that needs a '1 passed' result is therefore not-verifiable from this review. The gate cannot be closed as PASS until a shell-capable agent runs the delta commands listed in finding REQ-QA-001.

deliverable_checks.item: ARCH-002 decode-error hint fix: malformed bodies name category and position only, with a fix-the-body hint
deliverable_checks.notes: Static only. decode_failed emits '{what} is not valid: {category}{at}; fix the {what}' with no body bytes. fix_hint() wraps that detail in 'Correct the input so it matches the expected schema ({detail}), then retry.' Every message the new test checks is produced by this path. Execution of the test was not possible.

Static only. The three cases were traced: an EOF case (CheckRequest::parse), a missing-field case (RawCheckRequest has no defaulted fields, so it is a Data error), and a syntax case (CanonicalJudgePayload::from_bytes). Each yields INPUT_INVALID, contains 'fix the', and omits 'encoded', 'bug' and the secret text. No other test in the repository asserts the old hint wording (grep over crates and docs found none).

Without a diff tool, the annotated line could not be isolated. The pinned toolchain 1.94.1 is confirmed at Cargo.toml:21 and in CI, but that is not the annotation. The two closure-typed annotations in jev.rs (line 169 and line 174) are candidates only. The coordinator or a shell-capable agent must name the exact line from the commit diff.

deliverable_checks.notes: Frontmatter reads status: complete. The closeout note states that closure is recorded by the quality-mgr report, which the notes say is not required in this round. The 'Proposed, r-5' marker is absent from docs/architecture.md (acceptance row 'adr (r-5)'). plan.md has no conflicting r-5 status row.

findings.issue: The delta's acceptance evidence is missing. The sprint requires every command in the acceptance table to print '1 passed' and the required validation (just lint, just test, cargo test -p sc-jev-backends) to run. Static reading supports the hint fix but does not meet the execution requirement. This is a review-tooling gap, not a sprint defect. It is still a Blocking gap under the gate policy until the evidence exists.

gate_reason: FAIL. Static review of the delta found no requirement violation. The decode-error hint fix (payload.rs:104-119) emits category and position only, with no body bytes. The new test (jev.rs:362-379) traces to INPUT_INVALID with the fix-the-body wording on all three cases. REQ-SAG-0140 and REQ-SAG-0143 are upheld on static evidence. The status flip and closeout note are consistent with the absent Proposed r-5 marker. The gate still fails for three reasons. First, the acceptance commands that must print '1 passed' could not be executed (REQ-QA-001). Second, the '1.94.1 type annotation' in the delta could not be isolated (REQ-QA-002). Third, the new test is not in the acceptance table (REQ-QA-003, Minor). Per policy, not-verifiable items FAIL the gate. This reviewer cannot clear them, so a shell-capable run of the listed commands at commit 6972530 is needed before PASS. Branch and HEAD check: the worktree HEAD is ref sprint/r-5-jev-wire-envelope, which resolves to 69725308455bd8827b0a46e31e3f598327d66f55 (matches assigned commit 6972530), so input validation passed.
